tests: an adapter reporting completed without invoking the hook is refused with the scrub root intact, and the same adapter invoking the hook succeeds

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The completion precondition (src/spawn.ts:299) reads the file the GENERATED turn-end hook writes, and spawn runs that hook as a child process with spawnSync (src/spawn.ts:232), so red-witness rule (f) binds every witness whose members mutate src/spawn.ts. The capture at witness/captures/spawn-turn-end-hook-record.txt:1 is that hook's real output, taken 2026-09-16 on node v26.6.0 against a hook rendered by src/hooks.ts renderTurnEndHook(): an integer argument exits 0 and writes a two-key JSON record, and a NON-integer argument exits 64, writes nothing and prints "tiphys turn-end hook: expected one integer exit-code argument". The bad-argument arm is the shipped route to the absent record, so the named test reproduces both arms against a live hook before exercising the refusal. The two members are structurally different: member 0 never computes the evidence at all, and member 1 computes it from a stand-in record instead of the artifact, which is the guard running and looking at the wrong thing.
